verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: ہَلۡ اَتٰی عَلَی الۡاِنۡسَانِ حِیۡنٌ مِّنَ الدَّہۡرِ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ شَیۡئًا مَّذۡکُوۡرًا ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: There has certainly come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing spoken of.

verses.ar: اِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَۃٍ اَمۡشَاجٍ ٭ۖ نَّبۡتَلِیۡہِ فَجَعَلۡنٰہُ سَمِیۡعًۢا بَصِیۡرًا ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]We have created man from a mingled sperm-drop that We might try him; so We made him hearing, seeing.

verses.ar: اِنَّا ہَدَیۡنٰہُ السَّبِیۡلَ اِمَّا شَاکِرًا وَّاِمَّا کَفُوۡرًا ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: We have shown him the Way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ سَلٰسِلَا۠ وَاَغۡلٰلًا وَّسَعِیۡرًا ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ یَشۡرَبُوۡنَ مِنۡ کَاۡسٍ کَانَ مِزَاجُہَا کَافُوۡرًا ۚ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: But the virtuous drink of a cup, tempered with camphor —

verses.ar: عَیۡنًا یَّشۡرَبُ بِہَا عِبَادُ اللّٰہِ یُفَجِّرُوۡنَہَا تَفۡجِیۡرًا ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: A spring wherefrom the servants of Allah drink. They make it gush forth —  a forceful gushing forth.

verses.ar: یُوۡفُوۡنَ بِالنَّذۡرِ وَیَخَافُوۡنَ یَوۡمًا کَانَ شَرُّہٗ مُسۡتَطِیۡرًا ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: They fulfil their vow, and fear a day the evil of which is widespread.

verses.ar: وَیُطۡعِمُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰی حُبِّہٖ مِسۡکِیۡنًا وَّیَتِیۡمًا وَّاَسِیۡرًا ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: And they feed, for love of Him, the poor, the orphan, and the prisoner,

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُکُمۡ لِوَجۡہِ اللّٰہِ لَا نُرِیۡدُ مِنۡکُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّلَا شُکُوۡرًا ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: Saying, ‘We feed you for Allah’s pleasure only. We desire no reward nor thanks from you.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَا یَوۡمًا عَبُوۡسًا قَمۡطَرِیۡرًا ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Verily, we fear from our Lord a frowning and distressful day.’

verses.ar: فَوَقٰہُمُ اللّٰہُ شَرَّ ذٰلِکَ الۡیَوۡمِ وَلَقّٰہُمۡ نَضۡرَۃً وَّسُرُوۡرًا ﴿ۚ۱۲﴾
verses.en: So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them cheerfulness and happiness.

verses.ar: وَجَزٰٮہُمۡ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا جَنَّۃً وَّحَرِیۡرًا ﴿ۙ۱۳﴾
verses.en: And He will reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and a raiment of silk,

verses.ar: مُّتَّکِـِٕیۡنَ فِیۡہَا عَلَی الۡاَرَآئِکِ ۚ لَا یَرَوۡنَ فِیۡہَا شَمۡسًا وَّلَا زَمۡہَرِیۡرًا ﴿ۚ۱۴﴾
verses.en: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither excessive heat nor excessive cold.

verses.ar: وَدَانِیَۃً عَلَیۡہِمۡ ظِلٰلُہَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوۡفُہَا تَذۡلِیۡلًا ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: And its shades will be close over them, and its clustered fruits will be brought within easy reach.

verses.ar: وَیُطَافُ عَلَیۡہِمۡ بِاٰنِیَۃٍ مِّنۡ فِضَّۃٍ وَّاَکۡوَابٍ کَانَتۡ قَؔوَارِیۡرَا۠ ﴿ۙ۱۶﴾
verses.en: And vessels of silver will be passed round among them, and also goblets of glass,

verses.ar: قَؔ‍وَارِیۡرَا۠ مِنۡ فِضَّۃٍ قَدَّرُوۡہَا تَقۡدِیۡرًا ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: [✲]Bright as glass but made of silver, which they will measure according to their own measure.
w: which they will measure according to their own

verses.ar: وَیُسۡقَوۡنَ فِیۡہَا کَاۡسًا کَانَ مِزَاجُہَا زَنۡجَبِیۡلًا ﴿ۚ۱۸﴾
verses.en: And therein will they be given to drink a cup tempered with ginger,
w: and will they be given to drink

verses.ar: عَیۡنًا فِیۡہَا تُسَمّٰی سَلۡسَبِیۡلًا ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: From a spring therein named Salsabil.

verses.ar: وَیَطُوۡفُ عَلَیۡہِمۡ وِلۡدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوۡنَ ۚ اِذَا رَاَیۡتَہُمۡ حَسِبۡتَہُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤًا مَّنۡثُوۡرًا ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: And there will wait upon them youths who will not age. When thou seest them, thou thinkest them to be pearls scattered about.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَیۡتَ ثَمَّ رَاَیۡتَ نَعِیۡمًا وَّمُلۡکًا کَبِیۡرًا ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: And when thou seest thou wilt see there a bliss and a great kingdom.

verses.ar: عٰلِیَہُمۡ ثِیَابُ سُنۡدُسٍ خُضۡرٌ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٌ ۫ وَّحُلُّوۡۤا اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ فِضَّۃٍ ۚ وَسَقٰہُمۡ رَبُّہُمۡ شَرَابًا طَہُوۡرًا ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]On them will be garments of fine green silk and thick brocade. And they will be made to wear bracelets of silver. And their Lord will give them to drink a pure beverage.
w: and they will be made to wear
and will give them to drink

verses.ar: اِنَّ ہٰذَا کَانَ لَکُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّکَانَ سَعۡیُکُمۡ مَّشۡکُوۡرًا ﴿٪۲۳﴾
verses.en: ‘This is your reward, and your labour has been appreciated.’

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَیۡکَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَنۡزِیۡلًا ﴿ۚ۲۴﴾
verses.en: Surely, We have revealed unto thee the Qur’an piecemeal.

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُکۡمِ رَبِّکَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡہُمۡ اٰثِمًا اَوۡ کَفُوۡرًا ﴿ۚ۲۵﴾
verses.en: So wait patiently for the judgment of thy Lord, and yield not to any one among them who is sinful or ungrateful.

verses.ar: وَاذۡکُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّکَ بُکۡرَۃً وَّاَصِیۡلًا ﴿ۖۚ۲۶﴾
verses.en: And remember the name of thy Lord morning and evening.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الَّیۡلِ فَاسۡجُدۡ لَہٗ وَسَبِّحۡہُ لَیۡلًا طَوِیۡلًا ﴿۲۷﴾
verses.en: And during the night prostrate thyself before Him, and extol His glory for a long part of the night.

verses.ar: اِنَّ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ یُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡعَاجِلَۃَ وَیَذَرُوۡنَ وَرَآءَہُمۡ یَوۡمًا ثَقِیۡلًا ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: Verily, these people love the present life, and they neglect the hard day that is before them.

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنٰہُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَاۤ اَسۡرَہُمۡ ۚ وَاِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَاۤ اَمۡثَالَہُمۡ تَبۡدِیۡلًا ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: We have created them and strengthened their make; and when We will, We can replace them by others like them.

verses.ar: اِنَّ ہٰذِہٖ تَذۡکِرَۃٌ ۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰی رَبِّہٖ سَبِیۡلًا ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: Verily, this is a Reminder. So whoever wishes, may take a way unto his Lord.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ یَّشَآءَ اللّٰہُ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ کَانَ عَلِیۡمًا حَکِیۡمًا ﴿٭ۖ۳۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]And you exercise your will because Allah has so willed. Verily, Allah is All-Knowing, Wise.

verses.ar: یُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ یَّشَآءُ فِیۡ رَحۡمَتِہٖ ؕ وَالظّٰلِمِیۡنَ اَعَدَّ لَہُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِیۡمًا ﴿٪۳۲﴾
verses.en: He causes whom He pleases to enter His mercy, and for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.
